body.objective: Turn the terminal quartic-completion moduli theorem into a sharp observable statement: either construct a completion-independent nonlinear relational redshift, or classify the additional quartic theory data that experiments would have to calibrate.
body.stop_condition: When pulled, import the terminal certificate, completion-orbit representatives, admissible q3 family, pairing and detector-response disposition from observer-quartic-completion-moduli-and-observable-invariance by exact hashes. If a completion-independent response survives, construct one genuinely relational two-event frequency-shift observable from dynamical emitter and receiver clocks, transported phase, rods and detector records derived from the same action; prove gauge invariance, causal support, K_Berger covariance, backreacted rank, tangent-cone admissibility and exact sensitivity or insensitivity to Einstein-image, extra-Weyl and Maxwell inputs. If detector predictions vary across admissible completion orbits, compute the exact polynomial map from quartic moduli to the complete declared detector tensor, classify its rank, kernel, stabilizer orbits and blind directions, and prove the minimal number and type of independent calibration observables required to identify every observable coupling combination. If no admissible quartic completion survives the preceding identities, certify that the current action family has no nonlinear observer promotion and identify the smallest additional action representation that could change the obstruction. Land exact certificates, an independent verifier, causal/support and moduli mutations, an atlas update and a Paper 09 lifecycle disposition.
body.current_gate: completion-independent nonlinear redshift or exact calibration map for the quartic theory data
body.forbid: no coordinate-frequency ratio called redshift; no prescribed external emitter or receiver called dynamical; no q3, clock, rod or detector map imported from a different action; no completion-dependent prediction presented as universal; no raw-D claim where only K_Berger acts; no rank statement without the full declared detector tensor; no sampled coupling fit called moduli classification; no particle, positivity, quantum, scattering, phenomenology or all-orders promotion
activates: a same-action nonlinear relational redshift theorem
or a measurable-coupling calibration theorem for the quartic completion space
the public observable rung and Paper 09 final lifecycle review
body.resource_hint: OBSERVER RESERVE AFTER THE ACTIVE COMPLETION-MODULI TASK. Reuse one action-derived family throughout. If the moduli affect observations, treat them as unspecified theory couplings and compute the calibration map rather than choosing convenient coefficients.
notes: The current certified frontier contains twelve independent quartic q3 completions with identical q1 and q2; the active predecessor determines which survive the full identities and action equivalences.
A dependence on quartic coefficients is not automatically a failure: it may mean the theory needs additional coupling constants fixed by measurement. The deliverable is the exact distinction.
The item is input-pinned rather than dependency-gated so an OBSTRUCTED predecessor cannot strand the resident Observer stream.
